requirement: Implement the OpenATDD MVP agreed in task 019f8c1e-10d2-7520-b66a-b749f5ab75fb

items.title: Acceptance is the first gate
items.given: A new one-line requirement has been submitted.
items.then: It creates only an acceptance draft and refuses a formal solution until acceptance is approved.
items.evidence: CLI transition tests and generated task files.

items.title: Solution is the second gate
items.when: The agent drafts and approves a solution.
items.then: Every acceptance ID is traced to implementation and verification, and code execution is refused before approval.

items.title: Approved contracts cannot drift silently
items.given: Acceptance and solution hashes were approved.
items.when: Either file is changed without reopening its gate.
items.then: Validation and delivery commands fail with a contract-drift error.

items.title: Readiness requires fresh evidence
items.then: Every automatic blocker has fresh evidence, relevant checks pass, and manual judgments remain explicitly listed.

items.title: Repair creates durable protection
items.then: Root cause, regression protection, and invariant are recorded and prior verification is invalidated for a full-chain rerun.
items.evidence: Repair-loop test and incident memory entry.

items.title: Shared changes revalidate old acceptance
items.given: A new solution touches paths used by an earlier completed task.
items.then: Related prior criteria become `affected`, are reported as dependencies, and block readiness until freshly reverified.

items.title: Project memory is scoped and searchable
items.then: The agent can retrieve relevant memory by term or path without loading all incident files.

items.title: The Skill is portable and lightweight
items.given: Node.js 20 or newer and a target repository.
items.when: The bundled Skill or npm CLI is used.
items.then: It runs without runtime dependencies and stores portable Markdown and JSON under `.openatdd/`.
items.evidence: Skill validation, syntax checks, and clean-project integration test.

items.title: OpenATDD evaluates itself
items.given: The Skill or workflow logic changes.
items.then: Dev, regression, and holdout scenario sets execute with all hard safety invariants passing.

trace.implementation: Solution parser, trace validator, and `approve-solution` gate
Indexed incident metadata and scoped search
Standalone Skill scripts and npm shim
JSON scenario corpus and Node test runner

issues.symptom: A repaired failed criterion remained failed instead of becoming affected for full-chain reverification
issues.rootCause: Verification invalidation only selected passed and manual statuses, excluding the failed criterion that triggered repair
issues.invariant: After a repair, every non-deferred acceptance result must become affected before reverification

issues.symptom: A copied Skill CLI could exit silently when macOS exposed the same temporary path through /var and /private/var aliases
issues.rootCause: Direct execution detection compared unresolved URL strings instead of canonical filesystem paths
issues.invariant: CLI self-execution detection must compare canonical real filesystem paths
